issues.message: Baseline FPG 7.9/7.7/8.1 is reported in mmol/L, but the extraction labels it mg/dL.
issues.action: Use mmol/L and preserve the printed SE in a separate field.

issues.message: The Week 18 HbA1c responder odds ratios and confidence intervals are incomplete.
issues.action: Preserve OR 4.1 (95% CI 1.8-9.1) and OR 4.6 (95% CI 2.1-10.3) as ODDS_RATIO records.

issues.message: Published Table 2 safety categories are incomplete: drug-related, serious, deaths, genital infection, number of events per patient, requiring assistance.
issues.action: Extract every Table 2 category, subgroup and event-frequency row once, with n and percentage on the same observation row.

issues.message: A seven-day rescue-therapy condition is incorrectly represented as age eligibility.
issues.action: Remove it from eligibility; keep rescue-therapy rules in protocol/process metadata only.

issues.message: Basal insulin is required background therapy in this trial, not a prohibited medication.
issues.action: Represent basal glargine/detemir or NPH dose and stability as inclusion criteria.

limitations: A structural pass is not proof of scientific correctness.
For an unseen trial, scientific correction requires a source-grounded truth bundle or independent human/AI adjudication.
PRISMA compliance is assessed at systematic-review level, not as a property of a single RCT extraction.
